title: Stability of supermartingale optimal transport problems
summary: We investigate stability properties of weak supermartingale optimal transport (WSOT) problems on $\mathbb{R}$. For probability measures $μ,ν\in\mathcal{P}_r$ satisfying $μ\leq_{cd} ν$ (equivalently, $Π_S(μ,ν)\neq\emptyset$), we consider supermartingale couplings $π=μ(d x)π_x(d y)$ and the weak transport functional \[ V_S^C(μ,ν) := \inf_{π\inΠ_S(μ,ν)} \int_\mathbb{R} C(x,π_x)\,μ(d x), \] for some appropriate cost function $C:\mathbb{R}\times\mathcal{P}_r\to\mathbb{R}$.
